answer: Non-kin attestation quorums resist sybils: an identity counts only once enough established, UNRELATED peers vouch for it, and self-referential rings are discounted. A fake cluster is a closed loop vouching only for itself, no louder than a whisper across the tundra. Honest identities gather many independent vouches like a cedar ringed by a real forest; a ring has only its own, so the counting rule starves it however large it grows.
